description: Source code for QuicSpdyClientSessionBase class, implementing HTTP/3 and HTTP/2 session management, push promise handling, and connection control within the QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicSpdyClientSessionBase
classes.description: Implements a QUIC session handling HTTP/3 and HTTP/2 push promises, stream management, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: QuicSpdyClientSessionBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing session with connection, visitor, push promise index, config, and supported versions.

methods.name: ~QuicSpdyClientSessionBase
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up promised streams and deleting the connection.

methods.name: OnInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Processes headers received on a stream, associating them with promised info if applicable.

methods.name: OnPromiseHeaderList
methods.description: Handles push promise headers, validating stream IDs and updating state.

methods.name: HandlePromised
methods.description: Handles a promised stream, checking for duplicates and limits, and creating promised info.

methods.name: GetPromisedById
methods.description: Retrieves promised info by stream ID.

methods.name: GetPromisedStream
methods.description: Gets the promised stream object by ID.

methods.name: DeletePromised
methods.description: Deletes a promised stream and updates internal state.

methods.name: ResetPromised
methods.description: Resets a promised stream with an error code.

methods.name: ShouldReleaseHeadersStreamSequencerBuffer
methods.description: Determines if headers stream buffer should be released.

methods.name: ShouldKeepConnectionAlive
methods.description: Checks if the connection should be kept alive.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrame
methods.description: Processes SETTINGS frame, validating and applying settings, and handling zero-RTT resumption.
